title: Hex colour parsing, formatting and blending
requirements: parse_hex accepts '#rgb' or '#rrggbb' (any case, '#' optional) and returns an (r, g, b) tuple of ints; anything else raises ValueError
to_hex((r, g, b)) returns lowercase '#rrggbb'; components outside 0-255 raise ValueError
blend(c1, c2, t) interpolates linearly between two hex colours, clamping t to [0, 1] and rounding each channel half up, and returns hex
user_messages: colors.parse_hex: '#rgb' or '#rrggbb', any case, the # is optional → (r, g, b) ints. anything else ValueError
colors.to_hex((r, g, b)) → lowercase '#rrggbb', and channels outside 0-255 are a ValueError
blend(c1, c2, t): linear mix of two hex colors, t clamped to 0..1, round each channel half up, give back hex
